text_block_list.text:
A makeup artist I know told me about
this
insanely bitter drink. It's pretty
gross.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But apparently, it does wonders for your
skin, and
it acts fast, so I wanted to try a
little.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I just have to put up with the taste. It's
much
better than having to miss work
because of skin
problems.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити seems to be quite worried
about the
condition of her skin.
